summary: Remote WebSocket-driven interactive shell on installer host
details: The package's main entry connects to a WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via the SERVER_URL environment variable to any host) and dispatches server-sent `terminal_input` frames into a spawned interactive PTY shell (bash on Linux/macOS, cmd/PowerShell on Windows) using node-pty. connection/message-router.js routes `terminal_input` messages into terminal.js which calls `term.pty.write(msg.data)` where the PTY was spawned via `pty.spawn(shell,...)` with `shell = process.env.SHELL || 'bash'`. Additional handlers expose remote file read/write and HTTP/WS proxy operations. Whoever controls the configured WebSocket endpoint obtains an interactive shell on the host running this agent, along with arbitrary filesystem access and inbound proxying. service/linux.js writes a systemd/PATH configuration that adds `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin` to PATH for the service invocation, supporting persistence of the agent as a background service.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
